title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Retired Reserve Closing Reconciliation: Coverage-Type Changes Already Settled
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan: A coverage-type change already settled for a month of the closing period changes what that month's monthly bill brings into the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation: where a coverage-type change credit stands against that monthly bill, that credit is taken off; where a coverage-type adjustment bill for that month has a payment posted against it, the part paid is added; otherwise nothing is taken off or added.

**Terms.** The change credit is the total of the credits with reason coverage-type change against that monthly bill; the part paid is what has been paid against that month's coverage-type adjustment bill. The cases are read in the order given.

**Hypothetical.** A coverage-type change credit of 387.33 stands against the May monthly bill: 387.33 is taken off what that bill brings in. For June, an adjustment bill with 120.00 paid on it: 120.00 is added to what the June monthly bill brings in.
